description.en: The `search` field on the `Query` body (`POST /managed/query`, `POST /public/query`) accepts a small RediSearch-flavoured expression language. The name is historical: this is purely a **syntax** — the parser compiles it straight into SQL `WHERE` clauses, on PostgreSQL (full-text and pg_trgm indexes, GIN-indexed jsonb tests) or SQLite (FTS5). There is no Redis or RediSearch engine anywhere in the stack; every query runs against the database. This page covers **every operator** and **every value form**, with worked examples for each.
